data.title: Numbers — Beginner · Lesson 4
data.subject: numbers
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey! Let’s count the waves today…

[Hook]
Uno, dos… One, two
Vamos a la playa… Going to the beach
Tres, cuatro… Three, four
Learning numbers in the sun’s glow.

[Verse]
Sun’s up, it’s a beautiful day,
Vamos a contar… Let’s count okay?
Zero point one… Cero coma uno
Mitad de cinco… Half of five, here we go.
Double of six… Doble de seis
Tercio de nueve… One third of nine, mix it quick.
One fourth of twelve… Cuarta parte de doce
Décuplo de dos… Ten times two, can’t you tell?

[Hook]
Uno, dos… One, two
Vamos a la playa… Going to the beach
Tres, cuatro… Three, four
Learning numbers in the sun’s glow.

[Verse]
Triple of three… Triple de tres
Cuádruple de cuatro… Quadruple of four, can’t you see?
The ocean’s wide, the sky’s so blue,
A perfect day for me and you.
Uno, dos… One, two
Tres, cuatro… Three, four
Counting numbers, what a fun chore.

[Bridge]
Feel the breeze, hear the sea,
Learning Spanish, just you and me.
Let’s shout it out, let’s have some fun,
